title: Fix runtime error: useAuth used outside AuthProvider

requirements.text: Fix the runtime error "useAuth must be used within AuthProvider" by ensuring that all components that call `useAuth()` (including the router root component in `frontend/src/App.tsx`) are rendered within an `AuthProvider` tree, without modifying immutable files such as `frontend/src/main.tsx`.

quotes: useAuth must be used within AuthProvider

acceptanceCriteria: Launching the app no longer throws the error "useAuth must be used within AuthProvider".
`RootComponent` in `frontend/src/App.tsx` can call `useAuth()` successfully because it is wrapped by `AuthProvider` at runtime.
No changes are made to `frontend/src/main.tsx` (it remains unmodified).
Authentication-gated routing behavior remains intact (unauthenticated users see the Login page; authenticated users see the AppLayout).

constraints: Do not modify files listed as immutable, including `frontend/src/main.tsx` and the UI components under `frontend/src/components/ui`.
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Adding new authentication methods or changing backend authentication behavior.
Refactoring unrelated routing, pages, or UI beyond what is needed to eliminate the AuthProvider error.
